---
pagetitle: "Multi-Currency Treasury Reconciliation & P&L"
page-layout: custom
---

<iframe id="proj" src="https://marbul33.github.io/treasury-pnl-reconciliation/"
        title="Treasury P&L dashboard" loading="lazy"></iframe>

<style>
main.content, #quarto-content {
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
}

#proj {
  display: block;
  width: 100vw;
  max-width: 100%;
  border: 0;
  min-height: 850px;
  height: calc(100vh - 60px); 
}
</style>

<script>
const f = document.getElementById("proj");
const fit = () => {
  try {
    const h = f.contentDocument.documentElement.scrollHeight;
    if (h > 0) f.style.height = h + "px";
  } catch (e) {}
};
f.addEventListener("load", () => {
  fit();
  try { new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(f.contentDocument.body); } catch (e) {}
});
</script>
